newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo wins $180 mln Malaysian order.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo wins $180 mln Malaysian order.

text.p: Daewoo Corp, a unit of Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday it has won a $180 million order from Malaysia's Plaza Rakyat to build the second phase of the Plaza Rakyat building complex in Kuala Lumpur.

The construction division of Daewoo said in a statement that the complex, won on a turn-key basis, is scheduled to be completed by March 1999. The building will accomodate offices, apartments, department store, hotel and bus and train terminal.
The first phase, worth $280 million, was awarded to Daewoo in December 1992, it said.

Daewoo said its Malaysia construction contracts in total have reached $1.13 billion in the past three years, the largest among any foreign companies involved in construction in the southeast Asian country.
